title: Vingegaard wins Vuelta after final stage cancelled amid pro-Palestinian protests in Madrid
summary: Organisers cancel stage and declare Vingegaard winner Protesters threw barricades into the street on Gran Via Jonas Vingegaard of Visma-Lease a Bike won the Vuelta a España on Sunday after organisers cancelled the final stage amid pro-Palestinian protests in Madrid. “It is still unknown whether there will be a winning ceremony with the situation as it is, with thousands of protesters filling downtown Madrid,” organisers said. “The race has been officially ended and Jonas Vingegaard is the winner.” Continue reading...

title: ​Kim Seongmin, Defector Who Pierced North Korea by Radio, Dies at 63
summary: As a military propagandist, he fled the North by jumping off a train. In the South, he broadcast forbidden outside news to isolated North Koreans.
